title: Baton Board Oracle Projection
description: Portable public JSON projection emitted by a conformant Baton board oracle. The aggregate catalog form carries sourceRef topology identity for every discovered release; the named-release form intentionally retains its established top-level release/tracks shape and omits sourceRef. This is a derived read model, not the persisted board-v1 plan record.

projection_state.description: A slice-status-v1 lifecycle state, or the projection-only unknown sentinel when no valid status evidence exists.

dependencies.description: Declared predecessor track ids. Null is the compatibility spelling of an empty dependency list and consumers MUST normalize it to an empty array.

slice.description: Branch-accurate slice summary nested under its topology-owning track. Engines may add convenience or provenance fields; commands may require only the fields declared required here.

stateDurability.description: Evidence durability. Empty only when state is unknown and no evidence source was selected.

track.description: Track topology plus ordered nested slice summaries. Track lifecycle and operational convenience fields are optional and never command authority.

slices.description: Ordered slice summaries. Null is the compatibility spelling of an empty track and consumers MUST normalize it to an empty array.

sourceRef.description: Fully qualified selected topology ref. Empty only for the read-only no-HEAD filesystem fallback.

named_release.description: Compatibility shape for an explicitly named release. sourceRef is intentionally absent at the top level.
